"GOBLIN GLAM – THE FREAKY FASHION SHOW
3D Fashion Competition Game
Create a fully playable, visually impressive 3D fashion competition game with humorous, bizarre, dark, surreal and outrageous elements.

1. GAME CONCEPT
The player participates in an extravagant fashion competition against four AI-controlled contestants.

The competition consists of multiple rounds. In each round, a strange, absurd, controversial, surreal or ridiculous fashion theme is announced by a jury.

The player must create an outfit that matches the theme using a huge collection of clothing, accessories, jewelry, hairstyles and body modifications.

After creating their outfit, the player and the four AI contestants walk down a spectacular 3D runway.

A jury evaluates all five contestants and awards points based on creativity, originality, theme accuracy, visual impact and overall ridiculousness.

The contestant with the highest total score wins the competition.

The overall atmosphere should combine high-fashion runway shows, underground fashion, dark comedy, surrealism, fantasy and absurd reality television.

2. CHARACTER CREATION
At the beginning, the player creates their own character.

Available character species:

Goblin
Rat person
Character customization:

Different body types and heights
Different skin, fur and fantasy skin colors
Facial shapes
Ears, noses, teeth and facial features
Eyes and eye colors
Hairstyles and fur styles
Facial hair
Body proportions
Scars and unusual features
Optional fantasy mutations
Characters should have expressive faces, exaggerated proportions and distinctive animations.

The player can save their character and use it in future competitions.

3. THE FASHION COMPETITION
Each competition contains multiple rounds.

Every round follows this structure:

The jury announces a new fashion theme.
The player sees the theme and a short description.
The player enters the dressing room.
Five different fashion items are presented for each clothing category.
The player chooses one item per category.
The AI contestants independently create their outfits based on the theme.
All five contestants appear on the runway.
The jury evaluates each contestant.
Scores and rankings are displayed.
The next round begins.
The player competes against four AI models throughout the competition.

4. THE FASHION CATEGORIES
Create a large and diverse wardrobe divided into the following categories.

Each category should offer five randomly selected items per round.

The player should be able to preview every item on their 3D character before selecting it.

Clothing:

Headwear and hats
Tops
Jackets and coats
Trousers
Skirts
Dresses
Underwear
Bras and alternative upper-body garments
Socks and stockings
Shoes and boots
Accessories:

Glasses and sunglasses
Jewelry
Necklaces
Earrings
Rings
Bracelets
Piercings
Belts
Bags
Gloves
Scarves
Masks
Body decoration:

Tattoos
Face paint
Body paint
Makeup
Body accessories
Decorative prosthetics
Items should be visually compatible and attach correctly to the character model.

Allow the player to mix clothing from completely different historical periods, cultures, social classes and fashion movements.

5. FASHION DATABASE AND ART DIRECTION
The wardrobe should contain an enormous variety of fashion styles.

Include inspiration from:

Ancient Egypt
Ancient Greece and Rome
Medieval Europe
Renaissance
Baroque and Rococo
Victorian fashion
Edwardian fashion
1920s fashion
1950s fashion
1970s fashion
1980s fashion
1990s fashion
2000s fashion
Modern haute couture
Punk
Goth
Cyberpunk
Steampunk
Streetwear
Hip-hop fashion
Tribal and traditional clothing from around the world
Royal clothing
Military-inspired fashion
Workwear
Religious and ceremonial garments
Futuristic fashion
Post-apocalyptic fashion
Fantasy fashion
Completely ridiculous novelty clothing
The game should encourage unexpected combinations.

A medieval knight helmet with pink platform boots, Victorian underwear, oversized sunglasses and a futuristic handbag should be perfectly possible.

6. THE THEMES
The jury generates a new bizarre fashion theme every round.

Themes should be unpredictable, imaginative, strange, provocative, absurd and humorous.

Examples:

Funeral at a disco
The richest rat in the sewer
Goblin royalty on a budget
Divorce party in outer space
Medieval supermarket manager
Apocalyptic wedding guest
Your grandmother's worst nightmare
Alien aristocrat on vacation
The last fashion victim on Earth
Billionaire who lost everything
Sexy swamp creature
Intergalactic tax inspector
Royalty at a trash dump
The world's most overdressed prisoner
A vampire attending a children's birthday party
Fashion disaster at the end of the world
Ancient Egyptian nightclub owner
The most inappropriate outfit for a funeral
Themes should be combinable and expandable through a large random theme generator.

7. THE AI CONTESTANTS
Create four recurring AI-controlled fashion competitors.

Each contestant should have:

A unique name
A distinctive personality
A recognizable fashion style
A unique character appearance
Different outfit selection behavior
Individual strengths and weaknesses
Different reactions to jury feedback
They should make their own fashion decisions based on the current theme.

They should not simply wear random clothing. Their outfits should look intentionally assembled.

Give them entertaining personalities, such as:

An arrogant fashion diva
A chaotic underground fashion anarchist
An overly serious haute couture perfectionist
A completely clueless but surprisingly successful fashion disaster
Their outfits should change every round.

8. THE JURY
Create a jury consisting of three visually distinctive characters.

Each judge has a unique personality and evaluates contestants differently.

Judge 1: The pretentious fashion critic. Takes fashion extremely seriously and loves avant-garde combinations.

Judge 2: The eccentric aristocrat. Prefers extravagant, expensive-looking and completely excessive outfits.

Judge 3: The brutally honest fashion disaster expert. Enjoys bizarre combinations, absurdity and unconventional creativity.

The judges should deliver entertaining comments, sarcastic remarks, strange compliments and occasionally ridiculous insults.

Example comments:

\"I hate everything about this outfit. Which means I absolutely adore it.\"
\"A bold statement. Unfortunately, I have no idea what that statement is.\"
\"This is either fashion history or a cry for help.\"
\"I've seen better combinations in a dumpster. But not many.\"
\"Disgusting. Extraordinary. Ten points.\"
\"The shoes are a crime against humanity. I respect that.\"
9. THE SCORING SYSTEM
Each contestant receives a score from 0 to 100.

Scoring categories:

Theme accuracy: 25 points
Creativity: 25 points
Visual impact: 20 points
Fashion coherence: 15 points
Originality and absurdity: 15 points
The jury should provide individual scores and comments.

The final score is calculated from the three judges' evaluations.

Display:

Individual judge scores
Total score
Current ranking
Previous round ranking
Overall competition ranking
The scoring should be influenced by actual outfit selections and combinations.

10. THE RUNWAY
Create a spectacular, fully 3D fashion runway.

The runway should feature:

A large catwalk
Spectators
Flashing cameras
Dramatic spotlights
Moving lights
Background music
Fashion show sound effects
A jury table
Large screens showing contestant scores
Each model should walk individually down the runway.

Animations should include:

Different walking styles
Confident poses
Dramatic turns
Awkward walking
Exaggerated model poses
Funny facial expressions
Special poses based on the outfit
The player should see all five contestants in a short fashion show sequence.

The camera should switch between cinematic angles.

11. GAME MODES AND PROGRESSION
Create a tournament mode with several rounds.

The player accumulates points across all rounds.

At the end, the winner receives a trophy and a humorous award ceremony.

Possible awards:

Supreme Goblin Fashion Icon
Most Expensive Disaster
Worst Taste, Best Execution
Sewer Haute Couture Champion
The Golden Rat Award
Add unlockable clothing, accessories, hairstyles, tattoos and character customization options.

12. GRAPHICS AND TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS
The game must be a fully interactive 3D game.

Visual direction:

High-quality stylized 3D graphics
Detailed character models
Expressive facial animations
Detailed fabric and clothing textures
Realistic cloth movement where technically possible
Dramatic runway lighting
Colorful fashion environments
High-quality camera transitions
The game should feel like a combination of a professional fashion show and an absurd fantasy reality TV competition.

13. USER INTERFACE
Create an intuitive and attractive user interface.

Required screens:

Main menu
Character creation
Competition introduction
Theme announcement
Dressing room
Clothing category selection
3D outfit preview
Runway show
Jury evaluation
Scoreboard
Final awards ceremony
The dressing room must allow the player to rotate their 3D character and inspect all selected clothing items.

Every clothing category should be clearly accessible.

14. IMPORTANT GAMEPLAY REQUIREMENTS
The player must always compete against exactly four AI contestants.
All five contestants must participate in every runway round.
Every round must have a new theme.
Every clothing category must present five selectable suggestions per round.
All clothing selections must be visible on the 3D character.
The AI contestants must independently assemble their outfits.
The jury must evaluate all five contestants.
Scores must influence the competition ranking.
Outfits must remain visually consistent throughout the runway sequence.
The player must be able to complete an entire competition from beginning to end.
Prioritize a working playable game over complicated menus or decorative feature

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
